MFR_01_frozen_claim.exact_claim_text: Within the frozen G1 model class dx/dt = beta0*(Phi(x;s,c)-x), beta0>0, with M = D_x Phi at a fixed point, G1 = max Re eig(M) is a model-native scalar whose local linear stability boundary occurs at G1=1 because J = beta0*(M-I). This is a candidate mathematical construction only and is not yet an admitted biological Chi_bio.

Cancer-specific values remain prohibited until estimator/reduction freeze.
